name: Ticket peel
summary: Chip in on a friend's bad-luck fine: their windshield with the orange ticket cut into one strip per friend; tap to peel off your share with a little note, strips curl away until the glass is clear and they get a burst.
useWhen: a friend got a parking ticket or fine during a group outing: 'will got a $45 ticket while we were all in the water'
'let's all chip in for his ticket'
covering a small unlucky cost for one friend together
dontUseWhen: a planned gift for someone (use gift-pool)
paying back gas for a trip (use gas-pump)
a bill everyone ran up together (use a bill split)

where.description: Where and when, e.g. 'Lake Wren lot · lake day'

friends.description: Friends chipping in, 1 to 8, not the owner

notes.description: 1 to 4 short notes to pick from when peeling
